title: UI kit
lead: Every component a screen of the admin is built from, live, with the snippet to copy. Take a component from here; if none fits, add one to the kit, not styles to the page.

example.copy_failed: Could not copy; select the snippet by hand.
example.name: Name

general.title: General elements
general.lead: The controls of a form. A control with a `label` is the whole field; a bare control sits in a UiFormField of the page or in a toolbar and takes its ids from there.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.lead: One primary action per screen, secondary ones beside it, danger for what cannot be undone. A button that navigates is a UiButton with `href`.

data.title: Data
data.lead: Lists and figures: the table of a screen, the search and the filters over it, the badge of a state, the number in a card or a chip.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.lead: What the app tells the reader: a message that stays, a notice that passes, a dialog that asks, a placeholder while loading, an empty list.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.lead: Moving around a screen: tabs over one record, a menu of actions, pages of a list, the title and the crumbs at the top.

layout.title: Layout
layout.lead: The surfaces and lines a page is laid out with, and the tokens behind every color and radius of the kit.

softphone.title: Softphone
softphone.lead: The parts of a softphone in the manner of Click's dock: the dark bar along the bottom of the page, its panels, the collapsed button, the keypad and the icons it draws by Click's names.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.lead: The names in the kit's theme.css. A component uses them through Tailwind classes (bg-brand-600, text-ink-muted, rounded-card); no hex code anywhere else.

composition.title: A list screen
composition.lead: How the pieces compose: header, filters, a card with the table and the pages under it. Copy this structure for a new list screen.

UiInput.purpose: A single-line text control: text, email, phone, number, date, search.
UiInput.when: Any one-line value the user types. Give it a `label` and it is the whole field with hint and error; leave the label off inside a UiFormField or a toolbar.

props.modelValue: The value; bind with v-model.
props.label: The caption above the control. Given, the control wraps itself in a UiFormField.
props.hint: A line under the control that explains it; hidden while there is an error.
props.error: The validation message; marks the control invalid and describes it for assistive tech.
props.id: The id of the control, for tests and autofill; generated when absent.
props.required: Adds the asterisk to the label and `required` to the control.
props.disabled: Greyed out, not editable, not sent.
props.size: Height and text size; `md` is the default of every form.
props.placeholder: Grey text in the empty control; not a replacement for the label.
props.autocomplete: The autocomplete hint of the browser (email, tel, one-time-code).
props.name: The form field name, for a plain HTML submit.
props.autofocus: Takes the focus when the page or dialog opens.
props.invalid: Marks the control invalid without a message, when the message is shown elsewhere.
props.min_max_step_maxlength: Passed to the control as they are.

slots.leading: An icon on the left, inside the control.
slots.trailing: An icon on the right, inside the control.

events.update_modelValue: On every keystroke, with the new value.
events.keydown: Every key, for Enter and Escape handling in the page.

UiPasswordInput.purpose: A password control with the eye that reveals it and, on request, a judgement of its strength.
UiPasswordInput.when: Every password field: sign-in, the profile, the link that sets a password. Turn `strength` on where a new password is typed; the only rule the application enforces is `minLength`, the other checks only add to the word.

props.modelValue: The password; bind with v-model.
props.label: The caption; with it the control is the whole field.
props.error: The validation message; wins over the hint.
props.id: The id of the control; generated when absent.
props.name: The name of the control in a plain form.
props.autocomplete: What the browser may fill in: the current password or a new one.
props.required: Marks the label and the control.
props.strength: Shows the bar, the word and the checks once something is typed.
props.minLength: The shortest password the application accepts; the first check.

UiCopyField.purpose: A value to hand over, not to edit, with the button that copies it.
UiCopyField.when: A link the office sends by hand, a key, an id someone will paste elsewhere. The field is read only and selects itself on focus; where the browser refuses the clipboard the value is selected for a manual copy.

props.label: The caption of the field.
props.copyLabel: The word on the button; "Copy" by default.

events.copied: After the value reached the clipboard.

UiTextarea.when: Notes, comments, addresses of more than one line. Same field behaviour as UiInput.

props.modelValue: The value; bind with v-model.
props.label: The caption above the control; given, the control is the whole field.
props.hint: A line under the control; hidden while there is an error.
props.id: The id of the control; generated when absent.
props.placeholder: Grey text in the empty control.
props.maxlength: The most characters the browser lets in.

events.update_modelValue: On every keystroke, with the new value.

UiFileInput.purpose: A control that picks one file from the device.
UiFileInput.when: An upload in a form: a table to import, a document. The file goes up with the form; the server checks its type and size.

props.modelValue: The picked file, or null; bind with v-model.
props.accept: The types the picker offers, as the `accept` attribute (`.xlsx,.csv`).
props.label: The caption above the control; given, the control is the whole field.
props.hint: A line under the control; hidden while there is an error.
props.id: The id of the control; generated when absent.

events.update_modelValue: When a file is picked, or the pick is cleared (null).

UiSelect.purpose: A native select over a fixed, short list of options.
UiSelect.when: One choice out of a known list (status, team, plan). Up to a few dozen options; a search over many records is a UiSearchInput with its own results.

props.modelValue: The value of the chosen option; bind with v-model. An empty string is the placeholder.
props.options: The options in order; `disabled` greys one out.
props.label: The caption above the control; given, the control is the whole field.
props.hint: A line under the control; hidden while there is an error.
props.id: The id of the control; generated when absent.
props.placeholder: The first, empty option ("any", "no team"); omit when every value is a real option.

UiMultiSelect.purpose: Several choices out of a list, in a dropdown with a checkbox per option.
UiMultiSelect.when: A filter that takes any number of values (owners, tags, teams): it holds its place in a UiFilterBar like a UiSelect. A handful of flags saved with a form is a UiCheckboxGroup.

props.modelValue: The picked values, in the order of the options.
props.options: The choices, the same shape as UiSelect.
props.label: The caption; with it the control is the whole field.
props.error: The validation message; wins over the hint.
props.id: The id of the trigger, when a test refers to it; generated otherwise.
props.placeholder: What the trigger says while nothing is picked ("All lines"); "Any" otherwise.
props.searchable: A filter box on top of the list, for a long one.

events.update_modelValue: The new list of values, also after Clear.

UiChipGroup.purpose: One choice out of a row of chips that all show at once.
UiChipGroup.when: A pick that the reader makes by eye from a dozen or two short names, as the request guide picks a type, a problem and a brand. Picking the chosen chip again clears it. A few options with descriptions are a UiRadioGroup; a long list is a UiSelect.

props.modelValue: The value of the chosen chip, or null; bind with v-model.
props.options: The chips; `disabled` greys one out (a problem that does not fit the type).
props.label: The legend of the row.
props.error: One message for the whole row; wins over the hint.
props.mandatory: The choice cannot be cleared by picking the chosen chip again.

events.update_modelValue: When another chip is chosen, or null when the chosen one is picked again.

UiCheckbox.purpose: One yes/no choice with its own label.
UiCheckbox.when: A flag that is saved with the form (primary contact, accept the terms). For a setting that applies at once use UiSwitch.

props.modelValue: Checked or not; bind with v-model.
props.label: The text beside the box; clicking it toggles.
props.description: A smaller line under the label.
props.error: The validation message under the box.
props.id: The id of the box; generated when absent.
props.indeterminate: Some, not all, of what the box stands for is checked (the box of a group).
props.mono: The label in monospace, for a name from the code.

UiCheckboxGroup.purpose: Several yes/no choices under one caption, saved as the list of picked values.
UiCheckboxGroup.when: The roles of a user, the permissions of a role, the days of a schedule: a set of flags that is one field of the form, with one error.

props.modelValue: The picked values, in the order of the options; bind with v-model.
props.options: The choices: value, label, an optional description and disabled.
props.label: The caption of the whole group.
props.error: The validation message of the group.
props.columns: How many columns the boxes take on a wide screen.

events.update_modelValue: When a box is toggled, with the whole list.

UiSwitch.when: A setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped (auto-renewal, notifications). Where a Save button follows, use UiCheckbox.

props.modelValue: On or off; bind with v-model.
props.label: The text beside the switch; clicking it toggles.
props.description: A smaller line under the label.
props.id: The id of the switch; generated when absent.

UiRadioGroup.purpose: One choice out of a few that all fit on screen.
UiRadioGroup.when: Two to five options the reader should see at once (how to send: email, SMS, by hand). A longer list is a UiSelect.

props.modelValue: The value of the chosen option; bind with v-model.
props.options: The options; `description` adds a line under one, `disabled` greys one out, `depth` indents one a level of a tree and `group` makes it a bold heading without a radio.
props.label: The legend of the group.
props.name: The shared name of the radios; generated when absent.
props.error: One message for the whole group.
props.inline: Options in a row instead of a column.

UiFormField.purpose: Label, help text and error around a control, with the ids wired.
UiFormField.when: A field with more than one control (street and city), a custom control, or a bare UiInput the page wants its own layout for. A control given a `label` makes one of these by itself.

props.label: The caption above the control.
props.hint: A line under the control; hidden while there is an error.
props.error: The validation message; the control inside is marked invalid.
props.id: The id the label points at; generated when absent.

slots.default: The control(s). The slot props carry `id`, `describedBy` and `invalid` for a custom control; a kit control reads them by itself.

UiLabel.when: Only when building a custom field by hand; UiFormField and the controls render it for you.

props.for: The id of the control it names.
props.required: Adds the asterisk and a hidden "(required)".

UiHelpText.purpose: A line under a control that explains it.
UiHelpText.when: Only when building a custom field by hand; otherwise the `hint` prop.

props.id: The id a control points at with aria-describedby.

UiFieldError.purpose: The validation message of one control.
UiFieldError.when: Only when building a custom field by hand; otherwise the `error` prop. Renders nothing without a message.

props.id: The id a control points at with aria-describedby.

UiForm.purpose: A form that stops the browser submit, disables its actions while the request runs and shows an error that belongs to no field.
UiForm.when: Every form of a screen that the app posts.

props.processing: The request is running: the actions are disabled.
props.error: A message about the whole form (a business refusal), shown above the fields.

slots.actions: The buttons; a submit button here triggers `submit`.

events.submit: When the form is submitted; the page posts.

UiButton.purpose: An action, or a link that looks like one.
UiButton.when: Every clickable action with a word on it. `primary` once per screen, `secondary` beside it, `danger` for what cannot be undone, `ghost` and `link` for quiet actions in a row of text.

props.size: Height and text size; `sm` inside tables and cards.
props.href: Renders the app's link instead of a button.
props.download: With href: a file to save; a plain link the browser downloads, outside the app's router.
props.newTab: With href: the page opens in a new tab, a plain link outside the app's router; for a record the reader works on beside the list.
props.loading: The request is running: disabled, with a spinner in place of the icon.
props.wrap: The words break into lines and start at the left, for a link that is a whole sentence; by default a button keeps to one line.

slots.trailing: An icon after the word (a chevron for a menu).

UiIconButton.purpose: A square button with one icon and a label for assistive tech.
UiIconButton.when: Row actions in a table, closing a dialog, toggles in a header. The `label` is what a screen reader says and the tooltip shows; never leave it generic.

props.label: What the button does, in words.
props.href: Renders the app's link instead of a button.
props.pressed: Marks a toggle on or off (aria-pressed).

UiTable.purpose: The list of a screen: columns, rows, a slot per cell, sorting, an empty state, a loading state.
UiTable.when: Any list of records. With `sort` bound the parent orders the rows (the server, usually); without it the table orders what it was given.

props.columns: The columns in order; `sortable` adds the sort button, `align` the text alignment, `class` extra classes on the cells, `pinEnd` pins a narrow column of row actions to the right edge while a wide table scrolls, `hideLabel` keeps the header for screen readers only.
props.rowKey: The field that identifies a row.
props.empty: The words when there are no rows; the kit default otherwise.
props.sort: The current order; bind with v-model:sort when the parent orders.
props.loading: Skeleton rows instead of the data.
props.clickable: Rows react to hover, click and Enter; the parent gets `row-click`.
props.flush: No border of its own, inside a UiCard with padding="none".
props.mutedRow: A function of the row: true draws it dimmed (blocked, archived).
props.rowTone: A function of the row: a tone tints it (a running job green, a failed one red, a late one yellow), null leaves it plain. Write the state in a cell too: the tint is never the only sign. A muted row keeps the tint and dims its text.
props.pulseRow: A function of the row: true makes it blink red, to flag a record that waits for someone and nobody has taken. For what waits for someone now, never for a plain state; with reduced motion it stays tinted. Write the state in a cell too.
props.stickyFirst: The first column stays in place while a wide table scrolls sideways, so every row keeps its name: a dashboard of days with the metric on the left. Meant for tables without row tints, as the pinned cell has the plain background.
props.reorderable: A handle before each row moves it: dragged by the pointer, or with the up and down arrows while it has the focus (the focus follows the row). The table emits `reorder` and the parent orders `rows` itself; for an order the reader sets by hand (the ring order of agents). Keep buttons of their own for a touch screen, where a drag does not start.
props.rowLabel: A function of the row: its name in the handle's label for a screen reader ("Move Anna"); the row key without it.

slots.empty: The empty state, in place of the `empty` words (a UiEmptyState, say).
slots.footer: A row under the table, for a UiPagination.

events.update_sort: The order the reader asked for, when `sort` is bound.
events.row_click: The row clicked or entered, when `clickable`.
events.reorder: The row at `from` should move to `to` (indexes in `rows`), when `reorderable`.

UiSearchInput.purpose: A search box that searches once typing pauses.
UiSearchInput.when: The free-text search over a list or a lookup of records. The value is bound at once; `search` fires after the pause or on Enter.

props.modelValue: The text; bind with v-model.
props.placeholder: What to type; the kit says "Search" otherwise.
props.label: The name of the box for assistive tech; the placeholder otherwise.
props.loading: A spinner in place of the clear button.
props.debounce: Milliseconds of silence before `search`; 0 fires on every keystroke.
props.autofocus: Takes the focus when the page opens.

events.search: The trimmed text, once typing pauses or on Enter.
events.clear: When the cross or Escape clears the box.

UiCombobox.purpose: A search box with a list of options under it to pick from with the pointer or the keyboard.
UiCombobox.when: A lookup of records while typing that ends in picking one (a person by name, phone or email), with rows of its own such as "Create". The free-text search over a list on screen is a UiSearchInput.

props.modelValue: The text; bind with v-model.
props.options: The options in order; `key` names each, `heading` draws a caption above one to start a group.
props.label: The name of the box and of the list for assistive tech.
props.loading: A spinner in place of the clear button.
props.message: A line above the options: the text is too short, nothing was found.
props.prefer: Which option Enter takes when the options change: the first that passes, else the first. Enter waits while `loading`.

slots.option: One option, given `option` and whether it is `active`.

events.search: Once typing pauses, with the trimmed text.
events.select: When an option is picked by click or Enter.

UiFilterBar.purpose: The row of filters over a list with the Show and Reset buttons.
UiFilterBar.when: A list with two or more filters. The controls go in the slot; the page handles `apply` and `reset`.

props.columns: How many controls fit in a row on a wide screen.
props.processing: The request is running: the buttons wait.
props.applyLabel: The word on the submit button; "Show" otherwise.
props.resetLabel: The word on the reset button; "Reset" otherwise.

slots.actions: More buttons beside Show and Reset.

events.apply: On submit: the page reloads the list with the filter.
events.reset: On Reset: the page clears the filter.

UiBadge.purpose: A short status word in a tone.
UiBadge.when: The state of a record in a list or a card (active, failed, draft). `dot` draws the state as a point before the word.

props.dot: A colored point before the word.
props.outline: A border instead of a tinted background.

UiDescriptionList.purpose: A caption and a value per line: the "Information" block of a card.
UiDescriptionList.when: The card of one record (a user, a project, a role). A value that is not plain text (a badge, a list, a link) goes in the slot of its key.

props.items: The lines: key, label and a plain value; leave the value out when a slot draws it.

slots.value_key: The value of one line, by its key (`value-email`), with the item as a slot prop.

UiText.purpose: A run of secondary text: a note, the placeholder of an empty value, a name from the code.
UiText.when: Wherever a page would otherwise colour a span itself: "no roles" in a cell, "never" for a date, a permission name in monospace, a line of explanation that belongs to no control (that one is UiHelpText).

props.tone: `muted` for secondary words, `subtle` for a placeholder, `default` for body text in a mono or small run.
props.mono: Monospace, for a name from the code.
props.block: A paragraph of its own instead of an inline run.
props.lines: Keeps the line breaks of the text, as notes or a message are typed.

UiAvatar.purpose: The initials of a person in a circle, or their picture.
UiAvatar.when: A person in a header, a menu or a list.

props.name: The full name; the initials come from the first and last word.
props.src: A picture instead of the initials.

UiStatCard.purpose: One figure with its name: a card on a dashboard, or a chip in the header.
UiStatCard.when: A count or a sum the reader watches (tasks today, active members). With `href` it opens the list behind the figure; `compact` makes the chip of the header.

props.label: The name of the figure.
props.value: The figure; null draws a dash.
props.hint: A line under the figure (the card) or the tooltip (the chip).
props.href: Opens the list behind the figure.
props.loading: A skeleton in place of the figure.
props.compact: The chip form for the header row.
props.labelFrom: Compact only: the width from which the label is written out; below it the icon and the number stand alone.

slots.icon: An icon before the label (the chip) or in the corner (the card).

UiBarChart.purpose: Stacked bars: a column per day of a month, or a line per item with its total on the right.
UiBarChart.when: How a count splits over days or over groups (tasks done and overdue by day, tasks by team). A single figure is a UiStatCard; exact numbers to compare row by row are a UiTable.

props.series: The stacked parts of every bar, bottom (or left) first: a key into `values`, the word of the legend and the tone of the fill.
props.rows: The bars in order: `label` under the column or left of the line, `values` per series key, `hint` the longer name the tooltip shows (the full date).
props.orientation: `vertical` draws columns with a scale on the left and thins the labels when they crowd; `horizontal` draws lines with the total on the right.
props.label: What the chart shows: it names the chart for assistive tech and captions the table of numbers it carries.
props.empty: The words when there are no rows or every value is zero; the kit default otherwise.

slots.total: Horizontal only: the number at the end of a line, with `row` and `total` (a duration instead of a count, say).

UiMediaFile.purpose: A file a person sent: a picture shown in the page, a video or a sound played in place, anything else a link to download.
UiMediaFile.when: The attachments of a message (the pictures of an MMS, a file of a ticket) on its card. The host serves the file from its own address; an SVG is downloaded, never shown.

props.src: The address of the file, one the page's Content-Security-Policy lets it load.
props.contentType: The MIME type of the file as its sender named it: it picks the picture, the player or the link.
props.label: What the file is: the picture's alternative text, the player's name and the words of the download link.

UiTimelineBar.purpose: A day on one line: the stretches of a state along a bar, each in its tone with a tooltip.
UiTimelineBar.when: When a person or a thing was in which state over a span (an agent's day: offline, talking, on a break). How much of each is a UiBarChart or a table; the bar shows when.

props.segments: The stretches: `start` and `end` in the units of `span`, the tone of the fill and the words of the tooltip and of the list assistive tech reads.
props.span: The length of the bar in the same units (86400 seconds of a day); what no stretch covers stays empty.
props.ticks: Marks under the bar, `at` in the units of `span` (the hours).
props.label: What the bar shows: it names the bar for assistive tech.

UiPlaceInput.purpose: An address search with Google Places suggestions that fills street, city, state and zip.
UiPlaceInput.when: An address in a form: the person types, picks a suggestion and the form fields fill in, still theirs to correct. Without a Maps key it is a plain text box and the fields are typed by hand.

props.modelValue: The text in the box.
props.label: The caption of the field.
props.placeholder: The text shown while the box is empty.
props.country: The ISO code of the country suggestions come from; the US by default.

events.place: A suggestion was picked: `{ line1, city, state, zip }`.

UiRichTextEditor.purpose: Rich text with bold, italic, underline and two colours, as HTML.
UiRichTextEditor.when: A message whose look matters to the reader, as a note shown to the team on a record. The server cleans the HTML; the editor only offers the marks it keeps.

props.modelValue: The HTML.
props.label: The caption of the field.
props.id: The id of the editable area.
props.placeholder: The text shown while the area is empty.
props.labels: The words of the toolbar buttons.

events.update_modelValue: Every change of the text or its marks.

UiRichText.purpose: Text with marks that the server has cleaned, shown as it was written.
UiRichText.when: Showing a rich text saved by UiRichTextEditor, such as a note for the team. Never HTML that did not pass the server.

props.empty: The words when there is nothing to show.

UiStreetView.purpose: A picture of an address: Google Street View, or a map with a pin where there is no panorama.
UiStreetView.when: Beside an address in a form or a card, so the reader sees the building. It shows nothing without a Maps key or when Google refuses the pictures; it is never needed to fill a form.

props.address: The address Google looks up, in one line without the unit; nothing is shown without one.
props.unit: The apartment or suite, said under the picture.

UiMap.purpose: A Google Maps canvas with polygons on it, painted and culled by the parent.
UiMap.when: A screen that shows or edits areas on a map. The parent passes the polygons to keep on the map and a style per polygon, and listens to clicks, the pointer and the viewport. Give it a height with a layout class.

props.features: The GeoJSON polygons to keep on the map, by id; a new geometry under the same id replaces the old one.
props.featureStyle: The fill, stroke and visibility of each polygon by id; a new function repaints them all.
props.loading: Covers the map while the parent loads its data.
props.loadingLabel: The word under the spinner while `loading`.
props.info: The small panel in the corner: what is under the pointer.
props.label: What a screen reader calls the map.

events.viewport: After every pan and zoom: the bounds on screen and the zoom.
events.feature_click: A polygon was clicked; carries its id.
events.feature_hover: The pointer entered a polygon (its id) or left it (null).

UiCodeBlock.purpose: Preformatted text or data as the machine wrote it, with a copy button.
UiCodeBlock.when: A payload of a provider event, the extra data of a session, a raw request: something read by a developer or support, not by an operator. Data a person reads is a UiDescriptionList.

props.value: A string is shown as is; anything else as indented JSON.
props.maxHeight: How tall the block grows before it scrolls inside: `sm` 10rem, `md` 20rem, `lg` 32rem.
props.collapsible: Folded under its label (details and summary) until the reader opens it.
props.label: The name of the data: the summary when collapsible, a caption above otherwise, and the name of the scrolling region.

UiSwatch.purpose: A small square of a color, with the word it stands for.
UiSwatch.when: The color of a record that is drawn in that color elsewhere (an area on the map), or a key of a map legend. A state of a record is a UiBadge, not a swatch.

props.border: A border of another color; by default the fill.
props.size: `sm` for a row of a list, `md` with a thick border for a legend.

UiEmbedFrame.purpose: A page of another service inside ours, put in by that service's own embed.js and grown to its height.
UiEmbedFrame.when: A page of another service shown inside a screen of ours. Give it only an address the backend handed over at the moment the person asked (a short-lived ticket), never one built on the page; it loads `<origin>/embed.js` once, says loading and a failure in words, and removes the frame when it goes. An address that is not http(s) is a failure at once.

props.url: The address of the page, as the backend gave it.
props.title: What a screen reader says of the frame.

UiAlert.purpose: A message that stays on the page.
UiAlert.when: Something the reader should know while on this screen: a limit, a refusal, a warning about test mode. For the result of an action that just happened, raise a toast.

props.variant: The kind of message; `danger` is announced as an alert.
props.title: A bold first line.
props.dismissible: A cross that emits `dismiss`; the page hides the alert.

UiToaster.purpose: The corner where toasts appear; raised from code with useToast().
UiToaster.when: The result of an action that just happened (saved, sent, failed). The layout mounts one UiToaster and turns the flash of every response into toasts; a page raises its own with useToast().

UiModal.purpose: A dialog over the page with the focus trapped inside.
UiModal.when: A short form or a detail that does not deserve its own screen (add a contact, pick an address). Escape and the backdrop ask to close; the parent owns `open`.

props.open: Shown or not; the parent flips it on `close`.
props.title: The heading, which also names the dialog for assistive tech.

slots.default: The body; the first control gets the focus.

events.close: Escape, the backdrop or the cross: the parent sets `open` to false.

UiDrawer.purpose: A panel that slides in from the right over the page, with the focus trapped inside.
UiDrawer.when: The detail of a row the reader opens without leaving the list (an event from a log, a task from a board). A form that stands on its own is a UiModal; a record with tabs and history is its own screen.

props.open: Shown or not; bind with v-model:open.
props.title: The heading, which also names the panel for assistive tech.
props.size: The width: `md` about 28rem, `lg` about 40rem; the full width of a phone either way.

slots.default: The body; it scrolls inside the panel.
slots.actions: Icon buttons in the header, left of the close button (open the full record, copy).
slots.footer: The buttons, right-aligned at the bottom.

events.update_open: Escape, the backdrop or the cross: false.

UiConfirmDialog.when: Before anything that cannot be undone (merge, cancel, refund). The parent runs the action on `confirm` and closes the dialog when it is done.

props.title: The question.
props.confirmLabel: The word on the action button; "Confirm" otherwise.
props.cancelLabel: The word on the other button; "Cancel" otherwise.
props.processing: The action is running: the buttons wait.

events.cancel: The reader declined, pressed Escape or the backdrop.

UiSpinner.when: Inside a button, a search box or a chip while a request runs. For a whole block that loads, prefer UiSkeleton.

props.label: What assistive tech reads; "Loading" otherwise.

UiSkeleton.purpose: A grey placeholder in the shape of what is loading.
UiSkeleton.when: Lines of text, a block or a circle while the data is on its way, so the layout does not jump.

props.shape: Lines of text, a block or a circle.

UiEmptyState.purpose: What a list says when there is nothing in it.
UiEmptyState.when: An empty table, card or screen: the name of what is missing, a line about it, and the one thing to do.

props.title: What is missing.
props.description: Why, or what to do about it.
props.size: `sm` inside a table cell or a card.

slots.icon: The icon in the circle; an inbox otherwise.

UiTooltip.purpose: A short hint over an element, on hover and on focus.
UiTooltip.when: An icon button or a truncated value that needs a word; never the only way to learn something essential.

slots.default: The element the hint belongs to (one element).

UiTabs.purpose: Tabs over the data of one screen.
UiTabs.when: Sections of one record (contacts, addresses, history). Navigation between screens is the sidebar, not tabs.

props.tabs: The tabs in order; `count` shows a number, `disabled` greys one out.
props.modelValue: The value of the active tab; bind with v-model.

UiTabPanel.when: Inside UiTabs, one per tab, with the tab's `value`.

props.value: The tab this panel belongs to.

UiTabNav.purpose: The tabs of one record when each tab has its own address: links with an icon and a figure.
UiTabNav.when: A record worked on in sections that each open by URL, as a project with Overview, Tasks and Files. A column beside the record on a wide screen, a scrolling row on a narrow one. Tabs within one screen are UiTabs.

props.items: The tabs in order: `key`, the word, the address, an optional figure and icon.
props.current: The key of the open tab.
props.label: The name of the navigation for assistive tech.

UiDropdown.purpose: A menu under a trigger with keyboard navigation.
UiDropdown.when: Several actions behind one button (row actions, the account menu). The trigger is one element in the `trigger` slot; the items are UiDropdownItem.

props.align: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with.
props.side: Which side of the trigger the menu opens on.

slots.trigger: The element that opens the menu (one element).

UiDropdownItem.purpose: One line of a menu: a link or an action.
UiDropdownItem.when: Inside UiDropdown. With `href` it navigates; otherwise it emits `select`.

props.newTab: With `href`: opens it in a new tab outside the app's router (a screen of another app).
props.tone: `danger` for sign out, delete and the like.

UiDropdownSeparator.purpose: A line between groups of menu items.
UiDropdownSeparator.when: Inside UiDropdown, between unrelated items (the way out below the rest).

UiPagination.purpose: The pages of a list, with the first, the last and the neighbours of the current one.
UiPagination.when: Under a UiTable whose rows come one page at a time. The parent fetches the page it is asked for.

props.page: The current page; bind with v-model:page.
props.total: How many rows in all, for the summary in the corner.
props.perPage: Rows per page, for the summary.

events.update_page: The page the reader asked for.

UiPageHeader.purpose: The top of a screen: crumbs, title, a line under it, the actions on the right.
UiPageHeader.when: First element of every page. The layout persists, so the header belongs to the page.

props.title: The heading of the screen.
props.breadcrumbs: Where the reader is; the last crumb is the current page.

slots.meta: Small facts under the lead (an id, a date, a badge).
slots.default: Anything else under the header (a group nav).

UiBreadcrumbs.purpose: Where the reader is: every crumb but the last is a link.
UiBreadcrumbs.when: Inside UiPageHeader through its `breadcrumbs` prop; on its own only where there is no header.

props.items: The crumbs in order; the last one has no `href`.

UiChip.purpose: A small rounded label the reader can pick.
UiChip.when: Sections of a page, filter tokens, anchors further down the screen. The active one is marked; with `href` it navigates, without it emits `select`.

props.href: Where it navigates: the app's link, or a plain anchor when it starts with #.
props.active: The current one, painted in brand.
props.mono: Monospace text, for a code name.

UiKbd.when: A hint about a shortcut (Esc to close, / to search).

UiDisclosure.purpose: A block that opens and closes under its own title.
UiDisclosure.when: A secondary table or detail the reader opens when needed, as a "Done by day" table under a report. Closed by default; a block that is always needed is a UiCard.

props.title: The heading, which is also the toggle.
props.defaultOpen: Opens the block on the first render.

slots.meta: Beside the title, visible while closed (a count, a badge).

events.update_open: When the block opens or closes.

UiCard.purpose: A bordered surface with an optional heading row and footer.
UiCard.when: A block of a screen with its own title (contacts, addresses, a form). `padding="none"` lets a UiTable fill it edge to edge.

props.title: The heading of the block.
props.padding: `none` for a table that fills the card.

UiList.purpose: Rows with a line between them.
UiList.when: A short list of things with an action on each (the ways to sign in, the permissions of a group); the rows are UiListItem. A list of records with columns is a UiTable.

props.bordered: A border and a background of its own; otherwise it sits in a card.
props.divided: A line above the first row too, to part the list from what stands above it.

UiListItem.when: Inside UiList: a title with a line under it, an icon before it, the badge or the button after it.

props.title: The main text of the row; the default slot replaces it.
props.description: A smaller line under the title.
props.mono: The title in monospace, for a name from the code.
props.selectable: The title becomes a button that emits `select`: a list to pick one row from.
props.selected: Marks the picked row of a selectable list.

slots.default: The main text, when it is more than a title.
slots.trailing: What stands on the right: a badge, a button.

events.select: The title of a selectable row was pressed.

UiDivider.purpose: A line between two parts, or a word in the middle of one.
UiDivider.when: Between sections of a form, between items of a toolbar (`vertical`), or "or" between two ways to sign in.

props.vertical: A short vertical line for a toolbar.

slots.default: The word in the middle of the line.

UiAudioPlayer.purpose: The browser's own player of a sound file: play, pause, the time line and the volume.
UiAudioPlayer.when: A recording on a card. The page gives the file's address when it has one (a link asked at the moment of listening); nothing loads before the person presses play. `play` tells the page a play started, so it can renew a link that ran out; the exposed `element` starts, seeks and stops it.

props.src: The address of the sound file.
props.label: What a screen reader calls the player.

events.error: The file did not load (a link that ran out, a network failure).

UiAppShell.purpose: The frame of every signed-in screen: the dark sidebar with the brand, the menu and a footer, and the page beside it.
UiAppShell.when: Once, in the layout of the signed-in screens. On a phone the sidebar becomes a drawer behind a menu button in a top bar; it closes when the path changes, and `closeMenu` of the footer slot closes it before an item opens a dialog.

props.brand: The product's name at the top of the sidebar; its first letter is the mark.

slots.footer: Under the menu: who is signed in, the language, sign out. Gets `closeMenu`.
slots.dock: A bar along the bottom, UiDock: the sidebar and the page end above the band it publishes as `--voice-dock-height`.

UiNavItem.purpose: One line of the dark sidebar: a screen to open or an action.
UiNavItem.when: Inside the `nav` or `footer` slot of UiAppShell. With `href` it is the app's link and marks itself current while the path is `activePrefix` or under it; without `href` it is a button that emits `click`.

props.label: The words of the line.
props.icon: The icon component before the words.
props.href: The screen it opens; none makes it a button.
props.activePrefix: The path under which the line is the current one.

UiSidebarIdentity.purpose: Who is signed in, at the foot of the dark sidebar: the name and a caption under it.
UiSidebarIdentity.when: In the `footer` slot of UiAppShell, above the language and sign out.

props.name: The person's name.
props.caption: The line under it, usually the role.

UiSidebarSelect.purpose: A small native select drawn for the dark sidebar.
UiSidebarSelect.when: A short choice in the sidebar, such as the language. On a light surface it is a UiSelect.

props.modelValue: The chosen value; bind with v-model.
props.label: What a screen reader calls the select.

UiAuthFrame.purpose: The frame of the pages a guest sees: the product's name and one card in the middle.
UiAuthFrame.when: Sign in, a link that ran out, a page that cannot be reached without an account. Everything else is inside UiAppShell.

props.brand: The product's name above the card.
props.title: The heading of the card.

slots.default: The content of the card, usually a UiForm.
slots.footer: Under the card: a link or the language.

UiIcon.purpose: A Material Design icon by the name Click gives it (`phone`, `phone-hangup`, `dialpad`), drawn from its SVG path alone.
UiIcon.when: In the softphone and wherever a screen must show the same glyph as Click; elsewhere the kit draws lucide icons. It takes the size and the colour of the text around it.

props.name: The icon: a key of `ICONS` (`icons.ts`).
props.label: Names the icon for a screen reader; without it the icon is decorative.

UiDock.purpose: The softphone's frame, Click's VoiceDockBar: a dark bar 44 pixels high along the bottom of the page and, above its right end, the one panel open at a time.
UiDock.when: Once, in the `dock` slot of UiAppShell. The bar publishes the band it takes as `--voice-dock-height` on the root element (0 while collapsed), which the shell keeps free; `inline` puts it in the flow of an embedded page instead.

props.inline: In the flow of the page instead of fixed to the bottom of the window; publishes no height. For a page in a frame as high as its content.
props.collapsed: Hides the bar and its panel and shows the `fab` slot instead.

slots.default: The bar: chips, the number, buttons, spacers, the timer.
slots.panel: The panel over the bar's right end: a UiDockPanel.
slots.ticker: A line above the bar: a UiDockTicker.
slots.fab: What stands for the bar while it is collapsed: a UiDockFab.

UiDockButton.purpose: A button of the softphone, Click's `.btn` of the dock.
UiDockButton.when: `ghost` on the dark bar, `light` on a white panel, `green` to call or answer, `red` to hang up or reject. With `href` it is a link that looks the same (a `tel:` link).

props.label: Names a button with an icon alone; it is its tooltip too.
props.round: The pill of the call's main action.
props.active: Pressed: a toggle that is on (mute, hold, the open panel).
props.pulse: Breathes, as the Answer of an incoming call does.
props.wide: Across the panel, as its Dial.
props.small: Smaller, for a button on a line of a panel.
props.href: Makes it a link to this address.

UiDockChip.purpose: A pill of the dock, Click's `.chip`: the agent's status with its coloured point, the missed call to ring back, the second line.
UiDockChip.when: On the bar. A chip that holds buttons of its own (the second line's Answer and Decline) is `inert`.

props.dot: The point before the word: `ok` takes calls, `dnd` does not, `wait` is on its way, `err` failed, `off` is offline.
props.tone: `miss` for a missed call, `line` for the second line, `sudo` while an admin works as another agent.
props.label: The tooltip.
props.inert: A span instead of a button, so it can hold buttons.

slots.default: The word and, when inert, its buttons.

UiDockDialog.purpose: A question over the page and the softphone's bar, Click's CallMethodDialog: a title, its hint and the answers in a column.
UiDockDialog.when: A choice the dock asks before it acts: how to call a number. Escape and a click on the shade cancel; the focus starts on the control marked `data-autofocus`.

props.title: The question's subject, such as the number.
props.label: Names the dialog for a screen reader.

events.cancel: On Escape or a click on the shade.

UiDockFab.purpose: The collapsed softphone, Click's `.voice-dock-fab`: a round button at the right edge with the call's timer or an icon and the status point at its corner.
UiDockFab.when: In the `fab` slot of UiDock. It moves by the pointer and the arrow keys and snaps to the right edge, anchored to the nearer vertical edge; the host keeps the anchor (`parseFabAnchor`, `serializeFabAnchor`).

props.anchor: Where it stands: an edge and the offset from it; null is the default corner.
props.tone: Its colour: in an error, in a call, in the wrap-up; `wait` and `call` breathe.
props.dot: The status point, as on UiDockChip.
props.label: Its name and tooltip.
props.hint: A note beside it, shown while given.

events.expand: On a click that was not a drag.
events.move: With the new anchor, after a drag or an arrow key.

UiDockInput.purpose: The number field of the softphone, Click's `.quick-input` on the bar or, `wide`, its `.dial-input` across a panel.
UiDockInput.when: Where the agent types a number to call. Enter dials.

props.modelValue: The number; bind with v-model.
props.placeholder: The hint in the empty field.
props.label: Names the field for a screen reader.
props.wide: Across a white panel instead of on the dark bar.

events.focus: When the field takes the focus.

UiDockText.purpose: A word on the dock or in its panel, in one of its kinds.
UiDockText.when: `caller` who the call is with, `error` what failed, `timer` the length of the call, `empty` a list with nothing in it yet, `meta` the small grey line beside a row, `fab` the timer on the collapsed button.

UiDockSpacer.purpose: Between the dock's groups: a thin line or the room that pushes what follows to the right.
UiDockSpacer.when: On the bar, between groups of chips and buttons.

UiDockPlainButton.purpose: A bare icon button of the softphone, Click's `.plain`: no background or border, the colour of the text around it.
UiDockPlainButton.when: A small action in a panel's title or on the bar: settings, collapse, close.

props.label: Names the button; it is its tooltip too.

UiDockTicker.purpose: Click's live transcript line above the softphone's bar: who said the last line and the line, cut to one row.
UiDockTicker.when: In the `ticker` slot of UiDock while a call is transcribed.

props.live: The mark that the transcript is coming; null hides it.

UiDockPanel.purpose: A white card over the dock's right end, Click's `.voice-dock-panel`: a title, its buttons and a cross, then the content.
UiDockPanel.when: In the `panel` slot of UiDock: the history, the colleagues, the queues, the transfer, the keypad.

props.title: The title, which names the panel too.

UiDockTabs.purpose: The tabs of the softphone's panel, Click's `.panel-tabs`: one segmented row.
UiDockTabs.when: Over the lists of a panel. A tab's `badge` above zero shows beside its label in amber (the calls waiting in the agent's queues).

props.tabs: The tabs in order, each with an optional `badge`.
props.modelValue: The value of the active tab; bind with v-model.

UiDockRow.purpose: A line of the softphone's history, Click's `.vd-row`: the direction's icon in its colour, who, when, and the round green button that calls back.
UiDockRow.when: In the history list of a panel.

props.icon: The direction's icon: a name of UiIcon.
props.label: Who.

UiDockPerson.purpose: A colleague in the softphone's panel: the point that says whether their softphone is there, the name, the extension and status, and the button that calls them.
UiDockPerson.when: In the colleagues list of a panel.

props.online: Their softphone is there: a green point.
props.label: The name.
props.disabled: Greys the call button out when they cannot take the call.

UiDockLine.purpose: A line of the softphone's panel, Click's `.vd-row` of the Queues tab: a point, the label, the small grey meta and the line's action.
UiDockLine.when: A list in a panel that is neither the history nor the colleagues: the agent's queues.

props.label: The line's name.
props.dot: The point: `ok` or `off`; none without it.
props.meta: The small grey word beside it.

UiDockTarget.purpose: A colleague the call can go to, Click's `.vd-row` of the Transfer panel: the green point, the name, and the buttons.
UiDockTarget.when: In the transfer panel, one line per colleague who can take the call.

props.label: The name.

slots.default: The buttons that send the call or add them to it.

UiDockStatus.purpose: How an action of the softphone goes, Click's `.transfer-status`: a turning circle, a tick or a warning, read out as it changes.
UiDockStatus.when: Under the panel that started the action: a transfer, a participant added.

UiDockSettings.purpose: The softphone's settings under the panel's title, Click's `.audio-settings`: a bordered column of fields and buttons.
UiDockSettings.when: The devices and the like, opened from a button of the panel's title.

props.label: Names the section.

slots.footer: Under a dashed line: a reset.

UiDockSelect.purpose: A choice in the softphone's settings: the label above a full-width native select.
UiDockSelect.when: In UiDockSettings: the microphone, the speaker.

props.modelValue: The chosen value; bind with v-model.
props.label: The word above.
props.placeholder: A disabled first option, chosen while the value is empty.

events.focus: When the choice is about to be made.

UiDockMeter.purpose: A level in the softphone's settings: the label above a thin bar filled from 0 to 1, read out as a meter.
UiDockMeter.when: In UiDockSettings: how loud the chosen microphone hears the agent.

props.label: Names the level.
props.value: The level from 0 to 1; outside it is clamped.

UiDockTextarea.purpose: A few lines of text in a panel of the softphone, Click's `.note-area`.

props.modelValue: The text; bind with v-model.
props.placeholder: The hint in the empty field.
props.label: Names the field for a screen reader.

UiDialpad.purpose: The phone's twelve keys, Click's DIALPAD.
UiDialpad.when: In a panel of the softphone: to type a number, or to send tones during a call. `letters` prints the letters under the digits.

props.letters: Prints the letters under the digits.

events.press: With the key: a digit, `*` or `#`.

UiPhoneLink.purpose: A phone number one can call, Click's `.phone-link`: a `tel:` link with a dashed underline.
UiPhoneLink.when: Wherever a screen shows a number the agent may call. The page decides on `click` whether the browser follows the link or the softphone dials (`preventDefault`); the click and Enter stay on the link, so a row that opens on them does not.

events.click: With the event, before the browser follows the link.
